item.title: Brook ton takes England into T20 World Cup semi-finals
item.description: ENGLAND captain Harry Brook scored a century to guide his side into the Twenty20 World Cup semi-finals with a two-wicket win over Pakistan in their Super Eight match on Tuesday.Brook’s innings came after Pakistan’s Shaheen Shah Afridi (4-30) reduced England to 35-3 while they were chasing 165.The skipper recorded his highest T20 international score, reaching 100 in 50 balls with 10 fours and four sixes. England lost wickets late in the chase but crossed the line with five balls remaining.England
